comments: cb555372: This program is used for deleting incomplete patient records.
819d8363: Entry point for the program.
53d4647a: Check if division selection is enabled and prompt for division if it is.
feaf2e0e: If no division is selected, use the first division found in the file.
6efbb0b5: Ensure that the medical center division parameters for delinquency tracking are set.
b67bf5f2: Filter selection of patient records by division.
c6eb13dd: Prompt user to select a patient incomplete record for deletion.
0225caea: Prepare for editing the selected patient record.
2901b93c: Initialize variables for the OK to Delete process.
d6e048bd: Clear the return value for the list manager.
1476a057: Select items from the list.
db654961: Prepare the full screen before returning to the list manager.
5191592e: Process each selected item for possible deletion.
8f2d8633: End of the selection process, call report routine.
5fd4514d: Prompt for confirmation before actually deleting the record.
5cf47e51: If confirmed, delete the selected patient incomplete record entry.
fe861dac: Exit the deletion process if the user decides not to delete.
1aca1fcc: Flag to indicate user has decided to exit.
2fd1b1c9: Cleanup variables and exit the program.
6f4260ce: Provide instructions for yes/no prompt.
